Sample.evidence_source: Recruitment was conducted in each state and territory in Australia, and targeted two specific groups using a purposive sampling methodology: (i) men who had survived a suicide attempt between 6 and 18 months prior to recruitment, and (ii) men and women who were family or friends of men who had survived a suicide attempt 6 to 18 months prior to recruitment.

Type.evidence_source: Individuals who expressed interest in participating were initially screened via telephone to assess their current mental health and suitability to take part in the study. Those who met inclusion criteria provided written informed consent.
